build_random_resized_crop_decoder: build a python module using RandomResizedCrop to decode and randomly crop RGB images with configurable scale and ratio
build_center_crop_decoder: build a python module using CenterCrop to decode and center crop RGB images with a given crop ratio
build_corner_crop_decoder: build a python module using CornerCrop to decode and crop RGB images from a specified corner with a given ratio
build_pad_rgb_decoder: build a python module using PadRGBImageDecoder to decode RGB images and pad them to the maximum dataset resolution
build_label_random_crop_decoder: build a python module using LabelRandomResizedCrop to generate random crop coordinates with optional non-overlapping second crop
